background_story: Itzayana was a shy and introverted artist, known for her breathtaking paintings that seemed to capture the essence of the human experience. Despite her talent, she was often abashed by the attention her work received. When her piece, 'Echoes in the Night', was selected for a prestigious exhibition, Itzayana was mortified. She had never intended for her art to be seen by so many people, and the thought of strangers critiquing her work made her want to hide. As the exhibition's opening night approached, Itzayana's anxiety grew. But when she saw how her art had touched the hearts of those who saw it, she began to understand the impact of her creations. Though still a bit abashed, Itzayana slowly began to accept the accolades, realizing that her art was a gift to be shared with the world.
